rounds.title: PBE5AC_CHAMPION_V6_UPH_BUG05_ATPC_SYMMETRIC_LOCK_AND_SWR_LIMIT
rounds.hypothesis: Locking /proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/atpc to '1 -62 24 24 24' (symmetric 24/24 dBm min/max power so UPH-BUG-05 vec[2]/vec[3] inversion in init_ptmp_netconf cannot drop TX power during bursts) + swr_limit='6 6 2' on top of Stage 73A Champion v6 improves goodput stability and tail latency.

followup_scholar_queries: IEEE 802.11v Directed Multicast Service DMS multicast to unicast PtMP video
IGMPv3 fast leave wireless bridge multicast snooping airtime protection
